summary: Build practical humanitarian funding analysis, donor mapping, and tracking skills. Explore the five-day course outline and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Disaster relief funding coordination helps humanitarian grants officers, programme coordinators, and funding leads connect requests, donor commitments, and response priorities. This intermediate course supports the practical work of organizing response financing through funding-gap analysis and donor engagement. Learners review OCHA Financial Tracking Service data, map donors, align proposals with cluster priorities, and build tools to track commitments and reporting deadlines.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is for professionals who coordinate humanitarian response financing, prepare funding requests, track contributions, or connect programme priorities with donor engagement.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of humanitarian response planning, programme or grant operations, or donor-funded projects. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with your organization’s funding or reporting workflow if available; no specific software installation is stated as a requirement.
